name: Meet Fresh
notes: Chain (Taiwanese dessert). Selected the San Diego / Mira Mesa branch specifically (address verified: 9420 Mira Mesa Boulevard, matches work list) rather than a chain-wide page. 79 priced items across 16 sections (Cold Icy Taro Ball, Cold Icy Grass Jelly, Purple Rice Soup, Hot Red Bean Soup, Hot Grass Jelly Soup, Tofu Pudding, Small Bites, Traditional Milk Teas, Winter Melon Teas, Purple Rice Drink, Herbal Teas, Fresh Milk Drinks, Fruit Teas, Teas, Egg Waffles, Fruit Slush/Smoothies) from DoorDash schema.org Menu JSON-LD; a 12-item "Most Ordered" sampler section was dropped as duplicates of items already counted in their real sections. A SinglePlatform capture (places.singleplatform.com/meet-fresh-7/menu) was also found but is stale — its Traditional Milk Tea ($4.00) and Icy Grass Jelly Signature ($7.80) are 1.4x-1.7x below the DoorDash prices ($6.75 / $11.25), well beyond normal delivery markup, so it was not used. order.online storefront is a virtualized grid with no prices in the raw HTML (needs a browser); Grubhub is a pure JS shell.
